name: Exp_ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA custom indicator, which is a zero-lag momentum oscillator smoothed with OSMA-style processing. It opens buy positions when momentum rises and sell positions when momentum falls, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA自定义指标进行交易，该指标是经OSMA式处理平滑的零滞后动量振荡器。当动量上升时开多仓，动量下降时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于零滞后动量振荡器OSMA的多周期加权组合信号，通过5个不同周期的动量指标（8/21/34/55/89）按权重因子（0.43/0.26/0.16/0.10/0.05）叠加后再经双平滑处理，消除滞后性。入场条件为：当OSMA值从下穿上（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时做多，当OSMA值从上穿下（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时做空。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，同时配合固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MarginMode枚举提供5种模式，包括自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除浮亏后的保证金/余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理支持从保守的固定手数到激进的余额比例加仓等多种方式。策略在新K线形成时才计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，提高了效率。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a zero-lag momentum oscillator OSMA that combines five momentum indicators of different periods (8/21/34/55/89) weighted by factor coefficients (0.43/0.26/0.16/0.10/0.05), then doubly smoothed to eliminate lag. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the OSMA value turns upward (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell signal triggers when it turns downward (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions rely on opposing signal triggers for position closure, supplemented by fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing is managed through the MarginMode enum offering five modes including free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management supports a range from conservative fixed lots to aggressive balance-proportional sizing. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formation, avoiding redundant per-tick computation and improving efficiency.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot size or money management ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（保证金/余额/固定手数等）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取信号值的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal value retrieval

pros: 零滞后动量设计通过多周期加权有效减少指标滞后，信号更及时
新K线检测机制避免逐tick重复计算，降低计算开销和虚假信号
提供5种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好的交易者
买卖开关独立控制，可单独启用或禁用多空方向
依赖外部自定义指标通过iCustom调用，指标与策略逻辑分离，便于独立优化指标
pros_en: Zero-lag momentum design effectively reduces indicator lag through multi-period weighting for timelier signals
New bar detection mechanism avoids per-tick redundant computation, reducing overhead and false signals
Five position sizing modes provide flexibility for traders with different risk preferences
Independent buy/sell toggle controls allow enabling or disabling long/short directions separately
Indicator logic separated from strategy via iCustom call, enabling independent optimization of the indicator
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下动量信号可能失真导致不利入场
无持仓数量检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓导致仓位过重
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等波动性指标自适应调整，在不同市场波动下效果参差不齐
依赖外部指标文件ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA，若缺失则EA初始化失败且无自动降级方案
平仓完全依赖反向信号和固定止损止盈，缺乏移动止损或保本止损机制来锁定浮动利润
cons_en: No spread filter; momentum signals may be distorted in high-spread environments leading to unfavorable entries
No position count check; may repeatedly open positions in the same direction causing overexposure
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points without ATR-based adaptive adjustment perform inconsistently across varying volatility
Depends on external indicator file ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA; if missing, EA fails to initialize with no fallback
Exit relies solely on opposing signals and fixed SL/TP, lacking trailing stop or breakeven mechanisms to lock in floating profits
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈功能，根据市场波动自动调整止损止盈距离
添加持仓数量限制和同向重复开仓检查，防止仓位过度集中
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免不利条件下入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive stop-loss and take-profit to automatically adjust distance based on market volatility
Add position count limits and same-direction duplicate entry checks to prevent over-concentration
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid entries under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 无同向持仓重复检查，可能导致仓位过度累积
固定止损止盈在不同波动环境下可能不适用，极端行情下止损可能过小
缺乏移动止损机制，盈利仓位可能在回调中回吐全部利润
risk_points_en: No same-direction duplicate position check may lead to excessive position accumulation
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may be inadequate across different volatility regimes; stops may be too tight in extreme markets
Lack of trailing stop mechanism means profitable positions may give back all gains during pullbacks

summary_en: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA custom indicator, which is a zero-lag momentum oscillator smoothed with OSMA-style processing. It opens buy positions when momentum rises and sell positions when momentum falls, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.
